title: Guild Sponsors Free Art Events June 16
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder June 11, 2018

Dear Artists and Art Lovers:

YOU’RE INVITED!

The Guild of Harwich Artists invites you to a “Make and Take” event

When? Saturday, June 16, 2018, 1:30p.m. to 4:00p.m.

Where? Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Stret, Harwich, MA

Details? Guild artists will be demonstrating a variety of media;

Oil

Watercolor

Pastel

Colored Pencil

Chinese Brush Painting

Collage

Tables will be set up for the individual artists and attendees will have the opportunity to sit down and try out whichever media they choose, or may want to try two or three.  All materials will be provided.  Whatever works of art you create, you take home with you!

Sound like fun?  Come and join us.

The Guild will hold its monthly meeting at 1:00p.m., followed by the “Make and Take” event.
